description: Upcoming quantum computing events, soonest first, as summaries. Every filter is optional and they combine. Events are run by their own organisers; QDev checks each against its organiser's page. At most 50 a call; pass nextCursor back as cursor for more.

country.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (DE) or a country name (Germany).

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous call with the same filters.

from.description: Only events with a day on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: How many to return. 20 when left out.

region.description: A state or province, by ISO 3166-2 code (US-NV) or name (Nevada). Only some countries are searched by state.

tag.description: A subject tag, such as quantum, research or industry.

text.description: Words to look for in the title, summary, place, venue and tags. Every word must match.

to.description: Only events with a day on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: list_events
title: List events
